reviews.text: As usual great vet and staff.
The office is warm, friendly, organized and very clean. I love this vets office!

I use West Village Veterinary Hospital since they are close to me and I receive excellent care for my two brother cats. I am given suggestions to help them lose weight.

I also took one brother cat in for coughing and they gave me all the options for treatment.
Fantastic experience at West Village Veterinary Hospital. They were so kind and helpful and made a trip with my very anxious cat as easy as possible. Would recommend to anyone.
Best as always!
The staff is very caring. Highly recommend.
We are pleased to hear about your positive experience at West Village Veterinary Hospital. Thank you for taking the time to provide feedback!
Absolutely perfect service and solid pricing. Cannot recommend nurse Jon and Dr. Denton enough. So professional and on task while also being very kind and patient. Lovely staff

We love Dr. Hildenbrand and West Village Vets!  Great practice - Kind and skillful and consistently well run - I can always get an appointment when I need one and they run on time!!!  Dr. Hildenbrand helped me navigate through a series of challenging health issues with my last dog and she was incredibly supportive and always spent the time needed to make sure I understood all of the choices.  Care here is priced competitively and I never feel like I am being upsold a bunch of extra nonsense. Staff and vet techs are consistently terrific - I’m a big fan!

Scabs on dog post appointment

would not go back
Kind and patient front desk staff… Excellent Vet techs…. Superb Doctors…. for New York City, reasonable rates… highly recommend, both my dog and cat are patients
Kind and patient front desk staff, excellent vet-tecs and superb doctors ..highly recommend… everyone at dog park gives them rave reviews

Dr. Hildenbrand Is the best vet we have ever had. She remembers our dog and all of her issues. Very friendly and my dog is as comfortable as can be when we are there. She personally called my wife and I when my dog passed away with condolences and it meant the world to us. I would go here for my own care if they treated humans.

Do not go to them. They make everything difficult and try to extract as much money out of you as possible. They no longer let you fill prescriptions through third parties like Chewy and it's a way to force you back into their office. I tried to refill a prescription for a special food through their website (that my cat has been on for two years) and was denied because they're requiring an office appointment. I'm not spending $500 on an office visit (or whatever exorbitant price they're charging) for a healthy cat just so she can eat. Not in this economy.

Updated to add they're also incompetent or at least not great at cat care. For over 18 months I made multiple appointments because my cat was having what I eventually learned was asthma attacks. The doctor just prescribed allergy medicine and told me to continue to monitor. I made one appointment at West Chelsea Vet and they immediately diagnosed my cat with asthma and she's been better ever since. Absolute joke of a clinic.
Great place. Joanna was really helpful!🙏🏽 …
We are glad to hear about your positive experience at West Village Veterinary Hospital. Thank you for your feedback.

West Village Vet is just incredible.

I had two very medically complex senior pups and I was able to rest assured that I was always in good hands. The clinical care was thoughtful, detailed and compassionate. Dr Hildebrand in particular was incredible, always helping research the most fringe cases and helping us get into specialists.

I am so grateful.
Amazing team and doctor G is always fantstic. Best Vet in the area.
We are pleased you chose West Village Veterinary Hospital. Your positive experience means everything to our team!
Went in for a possible poisoning emergency. No wait, super friendly and efficient vet tech and doctor. Everything went great.

I brought my dog here in 2022 after our groomer — someone with years of experience working with animals — noticed something alarming on her skin and urged me to see a vet right away. When I brought this up to the doctor, she didn't take it seriously. Instead, she dismissed it with an arrogant attitude, asking "Where is your concern even coming from?" — as if a groomer who has seen hundreds of dogs over the years couldn't possibly know what they were talking about. She looked down on the groomer's perspective simply because they weren't a veterinarian.
She failed to diagnose my dog. Not misdiagnosed — she didn't catch it at all, even after I told her exactly what to look at and why.
By 2023, my dog was seriously ill. By the time we finally got the correct diagnosis elsewhere, it was too late. The disease had progressed beyond the point of treatment. I lost my dog.
The groomer was right. The vet was wrong. If she had put her ego aside for one second and actually listened — to me, to the groomer's warning, to anyone — my dog might still be here. But she was too proud to consider that someone outside her profession could spot something she missed.
This place may have high ratings, but I am sharing my experience so no one else loses their pet to a doctor's arrogance. Stay far away.

Terrible service!  AVOID!!
More concerned about $$$ than care.

Angela (as Dr H introduced herself) is beyond belief. Her clarity, thoroughness, lack of rigidity/dogmatism blew my mind. She carefully & sensitively explained the options, price & depth wise. No pressure. I found the pricing to be completely reasonable.

My cat was gently and lovingly (!!!) attended to. I’m gobsmacked.

I avoided vets for a number of reasons (pushing unnecessary vaccines…hope ya’all know about titres), tests and procedures. I absolutely won’t go anywhere else now.

EVERYONE, from receptionists to techs were so so caring, gentle and kind. This is the way the world should be. A deep bow of gratitude & congratulations to Angela.
Wonderful offices, lovely Staphane fantastic Dr. And so easy to deal with.

The ego and negligence of Dr. Sonia Gi ended up costing my sweet kitten his life.

He was not diagnosed in time and he died. He didn’t have to. He had FIP, a disease that used to be fatal—but now has a treatment with a newly FDA-approved antiviral (June 2024). That same drug saved my other kitten’s life (they were littermates), who was later diagnosed by a different vet who actually took me seriously.

From shortly after we brought him home at 8 weeks old, he had chronic upper respiratory congestion and red, bloodshot eyes that never improved. He was a ragdoll with bright blue eyes, and I even noticed the color starting to fade around the edges, turning white. I later learned this is a classic sign of uveitis—often associated with serious diseases like FIP.

We had already seen other vets and tried treatments with no success. At our visit with Dr. Gi, she made multiple condescending remarks that implied I was incompetent. When I explained that antibiotic eye ointment had already made his eyes worse, she responded, “Well sometimes it can be hard to get it in their eyes,” insinuating I didn’t know how to administer it properly. She made several similar comments throughout the appointment.

She dismissed his condition as likely herpes and prescribed another antibiotic—despite prior antibiotics having no effect. I asked for a herpes PCR test instead of guessing, and thankfully she agreed.

After completing the full course of antibiotics, nothing improved. When she left me a voicemail saying the herpes test was negative, she claimed it was probably due to a poor sample. This became a pattern: when something didn’t fit her assumption, she blamed execution rather than reconsidering the diagnosis.

I emailed her asking what further testing should be done given the negative result and lack of improvement. She never responded. I was completely ignored.

We proceeded with his neuter at the same practice but saw different vets. The managing veterinarian, Jessica Lee, did not comment on his severely bloodshot eyes. The surgeon, Gabre Denton, also said nothing. Three veterinarians saw my kitten, and not one suggested further investigation into a clearly chronic, unresolved condition—or even delaying surgery.

Two weeks after surgery, he became critically ill: high fever, not eating. At that point, I no longer trusted this practice and took him elsewhere.

Even then, he was not properly diagnosed and ultimately died.

When his sister began showing symptoms, the only reason we discovered it was FIP was because of a conversation with a natural pet food store owner. She had seen identical symptoms—red, inflamed eyes—in rescue kittens that turned out to be FIP. She told me about the new treatment, connected me to an FIP support group, and referred me to a knowledgeable vet. That vet diagnosed my kitten, and within 72 hours of starting GS-441524, she was back to eating, playing, and acting like herself.

I took my kittens to 4–5 veterinary practices, and in the end, it was a pet store owner who pointed me in the right direction. That is unconscionable.

In hindsight, my kitten had clear signs of uveitis—an important clue pointing to serious underlying disease like FIP. Not one veterinarian recognized it. I was a first-time cat owner. Why was it my responsibility to figure this out?

I also live with chronic illness and have experienced similar patterns in human healthcare—being dismissed, not listened to, and forced to figure things out on my own while providers assume they know best. It is deeply disturbing to see the same systemic failures in veterinary medicine.

I am absolutely disgusted.
We love Dr. Lee and the staff! Jamonsito is always taken care of x

Everyone at West Village Vet is supportive and kind and helpful. They have been very involved in the care of our elder dog (15y.o. Pomeranian) and this recent visit demonstrated they are just as present with our other dog, our tiny 7y.o.Chihuahua. Dr Gi is our primary vet and she is always available and sensitive to our questions and needs. We receive quick responses and their overall communication system is easy to navigate. We highly recommend.

I’m so grateful for everything West Village Animal Hospital does! I loved bringing my French Bulldog here when we lived in the neighborhood and always felt she received the highest level of care. Even after moving out of the area, I quickly realized it was absolutely worth continuing to bring my dog Pixie here because of the exceptional care she receives. Thank you to the entire team for everything you do!!
Great team! Our pet loves visiting and being treated here it’s also great that they spray pheromones to ensure comfort during a visit.
Fantastic vet. Unlike a lot of the other vets in the area, this place didn't feel like it was trying to extract every last dollar out of me.

My dog had a wonderful experience at west village animal clinic. From the time I checked in, exam room and checked out everyone was so helpful and made my dog so calm. He usually is petrified going to the vet. The nurses and Dr were fabulous with him! I would definitely recommend this clinic!
Great place. Take my kitties there all the time!
Everything is straightforward and they are kind to my dogs. Feels like an old school vet which is a great thing, not like they are overselling me on anything I dont need for my dogs.
Excellent care from Dr Connolly and her team!

My cats have had great care here (including surgery for bladder stones), and the vets are immensely respectful of owners in terms of explaining everything thoroughly and not dumbing it down. Also, their response to pet loss is not rote. My only complaint is that it's expensive, but so are all good vets nowadays. Having a pet is a luxury, and one is charged for it accordingly.

Dr. Denton is so incredible. I brought in my yorkie for his cough and I was scared because he hadn’t been checked in a while, didn’t have any paperwork anymore, is TERRIFIED of vets, and I had no idea what was going on with him. Really not great, but Dr. Denton took the time to thoroughly check (even double check) everything possible, go through every option, and explain literally everything to me so clearly without me even having to ask. Honestly I wish MY doctor was more like that. You can tell everyone here really cares about you and your dog and is really there to help. Even the Vet tech? Assistant? (Sorry I am uneducated) and the reception was super sweet. They also gave me a paper explaining everything they found in the visit. Just an awesome place super clean and calm, not anything like the scary waiting rooms with 10 yelping dogs I’m used to. Instead they have a coffee machine :) Go here, I hope the entire staff wins the lottery, vets deserve so much in life, etc
The staff are the best! My dog had a mini emergency and they fit us in. So appreciative.  The doc and tech were very attentive and provided a thorough examine. Very grateful.

Loved everyone!  The doctor and staff were absolutely fantastic with my extra large dogs.  Could not ask for better animal care delivered so nicely to owners and animals.  Cannot say enough nice things about the care for animals and their humans!

We have always had excellent service at WVVH - the vets are all so compassionate, as are the rest of the staff. It doesn't matter what we come in for. Additionally, they actually charge on par / less than many other vets that we've taken Lumi to.

Our little girl is so well taken care of here and we continue to come back even after moving to Brooklyn.

Huge thank you to Dr. Gi and Dr. Denton and the rest of the team for always being so good with Lumi!
